hf.title: Focused Omni-Modal GUI Agents
hf.abstract: Graphical User Interface (GUI) agents increasingly act over streaming omni-modal observations spanning screenshots, audio, video, interaction history, and device states. However, exposing this complete context uniformly at every step ignores that relevance is transient and sparse: the signal determining one action can become clutter at the next. Because executed actions feed back into the context, these errors compound into Sequential Distraction, driving the agent into irreversible trajectory drift. We formulate the underlying requirement as Focused Perception: a representation that is step-adaptive, action-sufficient, and non-intrusive. We realize this in FocusGUI, a lightweight adapter that dynamically prioritizes multimodal channels against a step-specific decision reference. Instead of uniformly processing all inputs, it compresses the most relevant evidence into a compact latent and subtly injects it into the frozen decoder's embeddings, guiding the model's attention without altering its native parameter space. FocusGUI trains from action supervision alone, requiring neither modality-relevance labels nor backbone fine-tuning. Across four omni-modal backbones, it raises overall Type Match by +33.2 and Exact Match by 3.0 times over the frozen backbone on average, and Type Match by +30.1 over the strongest existing enhancement method.
hf.titleZh: 聚焦式全模态 GUI Agent
hf.summaryZh: GUI Agent 需要在截图、音频、视频、交互历史与设备状态的流式全模态观测上连续决策，但若每一步都均匀暴露完整上下文，当下无关的信号就会淹没真正相关的信号；而且执行后的动作会反馈回上下文，使这类误差累积为「顺序分心」，造成轨迹不可逆漂移。FocusGUI 用一个轻量适配器依据每步的决策参考动态重排多模态通道，把最相关证据压缩成紧凑隐变量并注入冻结解码器的嵌入，在不改动原生参数空间的前提下引导注意力；训练仅需动作监督，无需模态相关性标注，也不微调骨干。在四个全模态骨干上，Type Match 平均提升 33.2，Exact Match 提升至 3.0 倍，Type Match 较最强现有增强方法高 30.1。
hf.reason: GUI Agent 全模态聚焦适配器，命中 Agent 与多模态理解方向

hf.title: Ropedia W0: Scaling Loco-Manipulation World Models across Embodiments with Human Experience
hf.abstract: World models enable embodied agents to anticipate action consequences, yet jointly modeling locomotion and manipulation across diverse embodiments remains challenging due to heterogeneous action spaces and limited multimodal supervision. We present Ropedia W0, the first egocentric loco-manipulation world foundation model spanning humans and robots with diverse embodiments. We curate Xp-Data, comprising 10k hours of egocentric human data and 3k hours of robot data with unified multimodal annotations and systematic quality control. A unified kinematic representation encodes locomotion through camera poses and manipulation through projected skeletons, with robot skeletons combining embodiment-specific forward kinematics with extensive manual keypoint annotation and correction. We also introduce Xp-Teleop, a long-horizon loco-manipulation benchmark based on high-quality dexterous humanoid teleoperation data. Evaluations demonstrate state-of-the-art performance across five cross-embodiment benchmarks (DreamDojo, Ψ_0, ω-HOME, Xp-Teleop, and AgiBot) and on held-out human egocentric video, from zero-shot inference to few-shot and full-data post-training. Scaling human pre-training data improves performance on both human and robot evaluations. After distillation, our model supports real-time, minute-long rollouts, enabling live VR interaction. Applications in policy evaluation, model-based planning, and world-action modeling further demonstrate the model's utility for embodied decision-making.
hf.titleZh: Ropedia W0:用人类经验跨具身扩展移动—操作世界模型
hf.summaryZh: 面向跨具身移动—操作世界建模中动作空间异构、多模态监督稀缺的问题，构建 Xp-Data 数据集(1 万小时第一人称人类数据与 3 千小时机器人数据，统一多模态标注)，并以统一的运动学表征刻画移动(相机位姿)与操作(投影骨架)，机器人骨架则结合各具身正运动学与人工关键点标注。在 DreamDojo、Ψ_0、ω-HOME、Xp-Teleop、AgiBot 五个跨具身基准及留出人类第一人称视频上取得领先结果;扩大人类预训练数据同时提升人类与机器人评测表现，蒸馏后支持实时、分钟级长 rollout 与 VR 实时交互。
hf.reason: 机器人与具身智能世界模型，按画像属低分方向

hf.title: Matrix-Game 4.0: Harnessing Video Models for Real-Time Playable Game Worlds
hf.abstract: Moving from controllable videos to genuinely playable worlds requires persistent world state, executable game rules, and low-latency interaction. We outline a roadmap for the next generation of Matrix-Game that separates game execution from visual generation through an executable game harness, and introduce Matrix-Game 4.0 as the first system built on this design. A lightweight game engine maintains world state and executes interaction rules, a multimodal coding agent translates player ideas into game code and dynamic scene captions, and a renderer based on autoregressive video model transforms engine-rendered low-poly proxies into detailed visuals, conditioned on dynamic captions and memory references. This framework provides continuous guidance for visual generation and enables natural-language creation and modification of scenes and gameplay. Our renderer is trained on aligned low-poly and high-fidelity video pairs and distilled into a causal generator that generates in four-frame chunks with one or two denoising steps. Together with targeted inference optimizations, Matrix-Game 4.0 enables 480p, 60 FPS gameplay on a single NVIDIA RTX5090 with a key-press-to-display latency of 112ms. Single-step generation achieves 83FPS steady-state throughput with 18.2GiB of peak GPU memory usage. With fixed prompts, steady-state throughput also reaches 67FPS on an RTX5080 and 58FPS on an RTX5070Ti. We demonstrate customizable shooter and driving games with engine-enforced mechanics, and release code, model weights, and low-poly game assets to support research and creation of playable game worlds.
hf.titleZh: Matrix-Game 4.0:利用视频模型构建实时可玩游戏世界
hf.summaryZh: 针对从可控视频迈向真正可玩游戏所需的世界状态持久化、可执行游戏规则与低延迟交互，把游戏执行与视觉生成解耦:轻量游戏引擎维护世界状态并执行交互规则，多模态编码 Agent 将玩家想法转成游戏代码与动态场景描述，基于自回归视频模型的渲染器再把引擎输出的低多边形代理画面转为高保真画面。渲染器在对齐的低多边形与高保真视频对上训练，并蒸馏为按四帧分块、仅一至两步去噪的因果生成器，结合推理优化在单张 RTX5090 上实现 480p、60FPS 游玩，按键到显示延迟 112ms;单步生成稳态吞吐 83FPS，峰值显存 18.2GiB,RTX5080 与 RTX5070Ti 上分别为 67FPS 与 58FPS。
hf.reason: 核心是视频生成式游戏渲染，偏离 LLM 主线，仅 Agent 与蒸馏效率略沾边

hf.title: PAR: Progress-Aligned Recurrence for Length Generalization in State Tracking
hf.abstract: Looped language models can run more iterations at test time, but additional iterations need not help them solve longer problems. For sequential state tracking, final-answer supervision does not specify how far each iteration should advance, and repeated updates can change the scale of the recurrent state. We introduce Progress-Aligned Recurrence (PAR), which trains the prediction at iteration k to match the state after the first k operations and rescales recurrent states to their first-iteration norms. On swap-S_5, a Qwen2.5-0.5B model trained on at most 32 moves achieves 95.5\% mean full-state accuracy at 512 moves, or 16times the training length, compared with 55.7\% reported for RLT and 0.8\% for explicit chain of thought on the same backbone. Controlled S_5 ablations show that removing norm anchoring reduces the extrapolation factor from 16times to below 2.2times, and replacing progress-aligned targets with final-answer supervision reduces it to at most 8times. A learned completion readout selects when to answer without a supplied stopping depth. When intermediate labels are unavailable, prefix self-distillation induces the correspondence from shorter problem prefixes using only final answers. The gains apply across sequential state-tracking tasks, establishing the task structure required for depth extrapolation. These findings support training intermediate predictions and state scale together to make additional recurrent depth useful for longer problems.
hf.titleZh: PAR：面向状态跟踪中长度泛化的进度对齐递归
hf.summaryZh: 循环式语言模型可在测试时多跑几轮迭代，但额外迭代未必能帮助模型解决更长的问题：只监督最终答案无法规定每轮迭代应推进多远，重复更新还会改变循环状态的尺度。PAR 让第 k 轮迭代的预测对齐“执行完前 k 步之后的状态”，并把循环状态重新缩放到首轮迭代的范数，从而稳定状态尺度。在 swap-S₅ 上，仅在不超过 32 步的数据上训练的 Qwen2.5-0.5B 在 512 步（16 倍训练长度）时达到 95.5% 全状态准确率，而同一骨干上 RLT 为 55.7%、显式思维链仅 0.8%；消融显示，去掉范数锚定会使外推倍数从 16 倍降到 2.2 倍以下，用最终答案监督替代进度对齐目标则至多降到 8 倍。该工作给出了使额外循环深度真正转化为长度外推能力的训练机制，并可用前缀自蒸馏在仅有最终答案时诱导出中间监督。
hf.reason: 循环架构与训练目标协同改进，长度外推数据扎实，命中预训练与架构方向

hf.title: CoEvo-RSI: When Harnesses Evolve, Which Models Should Follow?
hf.abstract: Model--harness co-evolution has emerged as a prominent paradigm for recursive self-improving (RSI) agents, jointly evolving their execution scaffolds and intrinsic capabilities. We study the persistent yet often overlooked brain--body mismatch problem in this paradigm, where an evolving harness (body) demands behaviors its model (brain) has not learned or restricts capabilities it already possesses. We introduce CoEvo-RSI, a RSI framework that advances model--harness co-evolution through agent-driven, bidirectional historical inheritance. Drawing on a shared evolutionary archive and execution feedback, a meta-agent coordinates harness development from historical designs with model checkpoint selection or merging and subsequent adaptation under the selected harness, aligning inherited capabilities with evolving execution requirements to reduce brain--body mismatch. Using only supervised fine-tuning (SFT) on its own rejection-sampled trajectories, CoEvo-RSI makes Qwen3.5-9B competitive with larger models across diverse vertical applications, including multi-agent failure attribution, role-aware text-to-SQL, and smart-home instruction following. It surpasses DeepSeek-V4-Pro on TraceElephant (+14.16 agent accuracy) and GLM-5.3 on HomeBench VM (+4.90 success rate), underscoring the need for brain--body alignment and the potential of bidirectional historical inheritance to advance agent co-evolution.
hf.titleZh: CoEvo-RSI:当 Harness 演化时，哪些模型应当跟随?
hf.summaryZh: 模型与harness协同演化是递归自我改进(RSI)Agent的主流范式，但演化中的harness(身体)常要求模型(大脑)尚未学会的行为，或限制其已有能力，形成被忽视的「脑—体失配」。CoEvo-RSI用Agent驱动的双向历史继承来缓解该问题:共享的演化档案与执行反馈之上，由meta-agent统一调度harness的历史设计复用、模型checkpoint的选择/合并，以及在选定harness下的后续适配。仅用对自身拒绝采样轨迹做SFT,Qwen3.5-9B即在多Agent故障归因、角色感知text-to-SQL、智能家居指令跟随等任务上追平更大模型，在TraceElephant上超DeepSeek-V4-Pro(+14.16 agent accuracy)，在HomeBench VM上超GLM-5.3(+4.90成功率)。
hf.reason: Agentharness与模型协同自进化，直接命中Agent与自改进方向

hf.title: S-Agent 2.0: Spatial Reasoning with a General Coding Agent
hf.abstract: Spatial reasoning asks a model to work out where objects are in 3D space, how they relate to one another, and how they move. Agentic VLMs have recently brought large improvements on such tasks by letting the model actively gather evidence with 3D perception tools instead of answering in a single pass. Even so, on many questions the tools return the right evidence and the model still does not arrive at the correct answer: the gap between model and tools, where raw readings become usable conclusions, is left unfilled. We present S-Agent 2.0, a spatial reasoning agent that equips an off-the-shelf general coding agent with a command-line perception toolkit, and we design the interface around one principle: help the VLM close the evidence loop: acquire scene evidence, remember it in a persistent scene memory, and interpret each reading in plain spatial language. This design keeps the full flexibility of a coding agent, and every reading it acts on stays grounded in the tools' geometry. On MMSI-Bench and ReVSI, the toolkit improves a strong open-source model, Qwen3.8-27B, by +13.9 and +20.5 points over the same agent without tools, and a strong closed-source model, Gemini-3.8-Flash, by +11.2 and +9.6 points. With the open backbone S-Agent 2.0 reaches 66.5 on MMSI-Bench and 82.3 on ReVSI, ahead of the specialized system SpatialClaw on the same backbone (62.6 and 74.5), and with Gemini-3.8-Flash it reaches 74.1 and 90.5 against its 67.0 and 79.7. Both tool gains shrink as the backbone grows more capable, but SpatialClaw's shrinks far more on ReVSI, from +13.2 to +2.7, while ours stays at +9.6. S-Agent 2.0 also works across different general coding agent harnesses, such as Codex and Claude Code.
hf.titleZh: S-Agent 2.0：用通用编程智能体做空间推理
hf.summaryZh: 空间推理要求模型判断三维空间中物体的位置、关系与运动；agentic VLM 借助 3D 感知工具主动取证已带来明显提升，但工具返回正确证据后模型仍常给不出正确答案，缺的是把原始读数转成结论的环节。S-Agent 2.0 让现成的通用编程智能体配备命令行感知工具箱，围绕「闭合证据回路」设计接口：获取场景证据、存入持久化场景记忆、用直白空间语言解读每次读数，同时保留编程智能体的完整灵活性。在 MMSI-Bench 与 ReVSI 上，工具箱使 Qwen3.8-27B 分别提升 13.9 与 20.5 分，Gemini-3.8-Flash 提升 11.2 与 9.6 分；开源骨干下达到 66.5 / 82.3，超过同骨干的 SpatialClaw（62.6 / 74.5），并可跨 Codex、Claude Code 等 harness 使用。
hf.reason: VLM 空间推理智能体，工具接口与 harness 设计扎实

hf.title: Sage-A1.5: From Long-Horizon Execution to Scientific Exploration with Capability Composition
hf.abstract: In this report, we introduce Sage-A1.5, a 35B Mixture-of-Experts agentic model that builds on A1 to advance long-horizon problem solving through adaptive capability composition. Compared with A1, Sage-A1.5 learns not only to solve individual tasks, but also to organize work and revise its approach during execution. Sage-A1.5 highlights three improvements: agentic orchestration, verification, and open scientific discovery. First, agentic orchestration extends single-agent execution through task delegation and parallel collaboration among subagents with isolated contexts, enabling complex tasks to be decomposed and addressed concurrently and supporting efficient execution while reducing interference across concurrent subagents. Second, agentic verification strengthens long-horizon reliability through progress checking, evidence validation, and reflective strategy revision, allowing the agent to recognize unproductive search paths and pursue alternative approaches. Third, open scientific discovery extends agentic capabilities beyond answering predefined questions to conducting exploratory research, connecting scientific inquiry with interactive analysis and inspectable research artifacts. We showcase these capabilities through complicated agentic tasks and multidisciplinary scientific applications. Besides, we hope Sage-A1.5 provides the community with an accessible foundation for open scientific discovery, offering a practical path from long-horizon task execution to collaborative, verifiable, and inspectable scientific exploration.
hf.titleZh: Sage-A1.5：从长程执行到能力组合的科学探索
hf.summaryZh: 面向长程任务中单智能体难以兼顾分解、并行与纠错的问题，Sage-A1.5 以 35B MoE 为基础，把「能力组合」作为核心训练目标，让模型不仅解题，还能在执行中组织工作并修正策略。三项机制分别是：智能体编排，通过任务委派与上下文隔离的子智能体并行协作来分解复杂任务并降低相互干扰；智能体验证，借助进度检查、证据校验与反思式策略修订识别无效搜索路径并及时换路；开放科学发现，把能力从回答预设问题扩展到探索性研究，产出可交互分析、可检查的研究产物。报告以复杂智能体任务与多学科科学应用做展示，未给出量化指标，定位是为社区提供开放科学发现的可用基座。
hf.reason: 35B MoE 智能体技术报告，编排与验证机制直接命中 Agent 与后训练方向

hf.title: VLA-Rolling: Fewer Denoising Steps, Better Control via Adaptive Action Reuse
hf.abstract: Flow-matching vision-language-action (VLA) models generate an action chunk by iteratively denoising Gaussian noise, but typically execute only a short prefix before replanning with updated observations. Under this receding-horizon paradigm, the unexecuted remainder---the action tail---is discarded, and the next chunk is regenerated from fresh noise. We show that this discarded tail retains transferable denoising progress: action-tail initialization can match or outperform a native 10-step Gaussian baseline using fewer denoising steps. However, the optimal denoising budget varies substantially across samples, indicating that tail reuse should be adapted to the updated environment. Based on this observation, we introduce VLA-Rolling, a lightweight inference framework that reuses action tails through three stages: action-tail inheritance, per-action confidence estimation, and confidence-guided refinement through renoising and denoising budget allocation, while the underlying VLA remains frozen. Across π_{0.5}, SmolVLA, X-VLA, and MolmoAct2 on LIBERO, MetaWorld, LIBERO-Plus, and RoboTwin 2.0, VLA-Rolling reduces action-chunk inference cost in all 16 model--benchmark pairs, achieving up to a 1.48times speedup, while improving success rate in 14 pairs by up to 15.08 percentage points. These results show that action tails are not merely discarded predictions, but reusable intermediate states that enable more efficient and accurate VLA inference. These results demonstrate that the action tail can support the generation of better actions with fewer denoising steps. Our project is available at https://chenbao123ww.github.io/VLA-Rolling/.
hf.titleZh: VLA-Rolling:更少去噪步数，借助自适应动作复用实现更好控制
hf.summaryZh: Flow-matching VLA 在滚动时域(receding-horizon)执行下只执行动作块的前缀，未执行的动作尾部被丢弃，下一块再从新噪声重新生成。该工作指出被丢弃的尾部保留了可迁移的去噪进度，可用作动作尾部初始化，在更少去噪步数下匹敌甚至超过原生 10 步高斯基线;但最优去噪预算因样本而异，因此提出三阶段免训练推理框架:动作尾部继承、逐动作置信度估计，以及置信度引导的重新加噪与去噪预算分配，底层 VLA 保持冻结。在 π_{0.5}、SmolVLA、X-VLA、MolmoAct2 与 LIBERO、MetaWorld、LIBERO-Plus、RoboTwin 2.0 的全部 16 个模型–基准组合上均降低动作块推理开销，最高 1.48 倍加速，其中 14 组成功率提升最多 15.08 个百分点。
hf.reason: VLA 机器人策略推理加速，属具身智能方向，按画像低分

hf.title: SolarRenderer: Few-Step Generative Reference Rendering
hf.abstract: Game engines and coding agents can specify the layout, motion, and camera of a scene, yet turning such coarse structure into realistic video requires a renderer that follows the structure and completes the appearance it leaves open. Existing renderers are tied to the representation of one engine, need tens of denoising steps or a costly distillation of their own, and learn from conditions that are not aligned with their target videos. We present SolarRenderer, a structure-conditioned video renderer that adapts a frozen MiniMax-H3 33B backbone with two lightweight LoRAs. Structural videos enter the native reference pathway of the backbone at the positions of the frames they describe, without a type identifier and described only in plain text, so that a single control LoRA follows arbitrary structural representations. Starting from a pretrained four-step LoRA, structure-guided distribution matching renders in four steps, 12.3 times faster than 50-step sampling, while preserving the learned control. A block-causal variant extends the same design to streaming and renders 768p video in real time. To train the model, we build a frame-aligned corpus of 136K clips from game engines, simulators, and YouTube videos. Experiments on an in-distribution test set and a generalization benchmark of 16 structural representations show that SolarRenderer achieves state-of-the-art results across both, and generalizes to 11 unseen representations, including pose skeletons, drawings, and point clouds.
hf.titleZh: SolarRenderer：少步数生成式参考渲染
hf.summaryZh: 游戏引擎与编程智能体能够指定场景的布局、运动和相机，但要把这种粗粒度结构转成真实视频，仍需一个既能遵循结构、又能补全外观的渲染器。SolarRenderer 在冻结的 MiniMax-H3 33B 骨干上挂载两个轻量 LoRA：结构视频仅以纯文本描述、不带类型标识地进入骨干原生的 reference 通路，因此单个控制 LoRA 即可适配任意结构表示。该方法从预训练的四步 LoRA 出发，用结构引导的分布匹配实现四步渲染，比 50 步采样快 12.3 倍，块因果变体进一步支持流式实时渲染 768p 视频。团队构建了 136K 帧对齐片段语料，在分布内测试集与覆盖 16 种结构表示的泛化基准上均取得最优结果，并可泛化到姿态骨架、手绘、点云等 11 种未见过表示。
hf.reason: 视频生成与扩散渲染，属低分方向，仅效率层面略相关

hf.title: Learning the 4D World through Point Trajectory Forecasting
hf.abstract: Reliable multi-view forecasting requires videos from different cameras to describe the same evolving 3D scene. To this end, we introduce Video-Point Model (VPM), a world model that conditions on multi-view video histories and a language instruction to jointly forecast future videos from arbitrary viewpoints and the 3D trajectories of persistent scene points. We extend a pretrained world model with camera-conditioned multi-view processing that integrates complementary observations across cameras, and add a trajectory head that predicts how physical points move through time. Each trajectory tracks a single point across all views, and supervising these trajectories alongside video generation therefore anchors appearance changes in every camera to a shared description of 3D motion. To support training and evaluation, we build VPM-Data, a simulation corpus pairing synchronized multi-view videos with persistent point trajectories, and VP-WorldBench, a forecasting benchmark spanning simulated and real environments. We further extend VPM to robot control by adding robot actions as a token modality in the generator. Action tokens share the point-supervised backbone and are denoised jointly with future videos, thereby grounding the policy in the same 3D-aware representation. On VP-WorldBench and existing 4D generation benchmarks, point supervision improves both video fidelity and 3D motion accuracy over a video-only counterpart, and in simulated and real-robot experiments, it also raises the manipulation success of the action-enabled model.
hf.titleZh: 通过点轨迹预测学习 4D 世界
hf.summaryZh: 面向多视角视频预测需各相机描述同一 evolving 3D 场景的问题，构建 Video-Point Model(VPM):以多视角视频历史与语言指令为条件，联合预测任意视角的未来视频与持续场景点的 3D 轨迹;在预训练世界模型上加入相机条件化的多视角处理与轨迹头，每条轨迹跨所有视角跟踪同一物理点，从而将各相机的外观变化锚定到共享的 3D 运动描述。配套构建仿真数据 VPM-Data 与涵盖仿真和真实环境的 VP-WorldBench 基准;将动作作为 token 模态接入同一骨干，使策略接地于 3D 感知表征。在 VP-WorldBench 与现有 4D 生成基准上，点监督相对纯视频基线提升了视频保真度与 3D 运动精度，并在仿真与真机实验中提高了操作任务成功率。
hf.reason: 视频/4D 生成世界模型加机器人操作，落在低分方向

hf.title: Correction Training for Diffusion Models
hf.abstract: Iterative sampling in diffusion models can lead to error accumulation due to exposure bias. The denoiser is trained on real images interpolated with noise, but at inference its inputs are constructed from its own imperfect predictions from the earlier steps, something it has never seen at training time. This might be one reason diffusion models often struggle without additional help, such as CFG. We introduce a correction step for diffusion models which attempts to reduce this training-inference gap. The corrector takes the base model's prediction as input and is trained against the same ground-truth target. This makes correction an explicit learning task, with training inputs provided by the base model. During sampling, at each denoising step, we iteratively refine the denoiser's clean-sample prediction. This allows us to correct predictions at intermediate denoising steps, preventing early artifacts from persisting into the final sample. Although the corrector is trained only on predictions from the base denoiser, it can be applied repeatedly to its own outputs at inference for better results. This simple framework leads to substantial improvement in sample quality while largely preserving diversity. We evaluate our method across DiT, SiT, and JiT. Our method substantially improves upon previously reported FID scores for unguided generation and, notably, unconditional generation, where producing high-quality samples without guidance has been particularly challenging. Our method achieves performance competitive with classifier-free guidance (CFG), and combining correction with CFG further improves diversity and reduces oversaturation typical of CFG. Finally, we show that the additional inference cost of correction can be amortized by distilling the refined predictions back into the base diffusion model, retaining the quality gains without additional inference-time overhead.
hf.titleZh: 扩散模型的校正训练
hf.summaryZh: 扩散模型迭代采样存在暴露偏差：去噪器训练时输入是加噪的真实图像，推理时输入却来自自身前几步的不完美预测，误差逐步累积，缺乏 CFG 等辅助手段时采样质量明显下降。为此在基础模型之上引入校正器，以基础模型的干净样本预测为输入、以同一真值目标训练，把校正变成显式学习任务；采样时在每个去噪步迭代精炼该预测，并可在推理阶段重复作用于自身输出。在 DiT、SiT、JiT 上，该方法大幅改善无引导与无条件生成的 FID，效果与 CFG 相当，与 CFG 结合还能提升多样性、缓解过饱和；将精炼预测蒸馏回基础模型可摊薄额外推理开销。
hf.reason: 扩散模型采样改进，属画像明确排除的扩散方向

hf.title: SWIFT: Self-guided Weak-to-strong dIFfusion models via Target extrapolation
hf.abstract: Training high-quality diffusion models is computationally expensive, and inference-time guidance often adds further sampling cost. In this work, we introduce Swift, a simple yet effective self-guided training method that uses a frozen weak denoiser to improve a stronger model without adding inference overhead. For each noisy input, Swift extrapolates the clean regression target away from the weak denoiser's prediction, amplifying components that remain underfit. The weak guide can be an early training checkpoint, requires no backpropagation during main-model training, and is discarded afterward. The resulting model retains the original sampler and supports both conditional and unconditional generation without label dropout or an unconditional branch. We explain this mechanism through a spectral analysis of finite-time population gradient flow in an RKHS. With an early-stopped weak guide, we prove that a nonempty range of extrapolation strengths yields strictly lower posterior-mean error than matched standard training, despite shifting the regression target away from the posterior mean. Experiments on CIFAR-10 and ImageNet-256 demonstrate improvements across model scales and representations. In one ImageNet-256 configuration, Swift surpasses the baseline's best FID using roughly half the total training compute, including guide preparation and training overhead. On RAEv2, it achieves FID 1.15 without inference-time guidance and 0.99 with guidance. These results establish target extrapolation as an effective approach to weak-to-strong diffusion training with efficient single-model inference.
hf.titleZh: SWIFT:通过目标外推实现自引导的弱到强扩散模型
hf.summaryZh: 扩散模型训练成本高昂，推理时引导又进一步增加采样开销。SWIFT用训练早期的弱去噪器作为冻结引导，对每个噪声输入把干净回归目标朝远离弱模型预测的方向外推，放大仍欠拟合的分量，主模型训练无需反向传播、结束后丢弃引导模型，推理时保持原采样器且无需标签丢弃或无条件分支。作者用RKHS中有限时间群体梯度流的谱分析解释该机制，并证明早停的弱引导下存在非空的外推强度区间使后验均值误差严格低于标准训练。在CIFAR-10与ImageNet-256上跨模型规模均取得提升，某ImageNet-256配置下用约一半总训练算力超过基线的FID,RAEv2上无引导FID为1.15、有引导为0.99。
hf.reason: 扩散模型训练方法，属明确不关注的视觉生成方向

hf.title: MMEnterprise-Bench: Evaluating Enterprise Agents over Evolving Multimodal Records
hf.abstract: Enterprise agents answer questions over workplace records that evolve through team collaboration. As information is shared, corrected, and revised across documents, chats, and figures, multiple versions of the same information accumulate in the workspace. Reliable question answering therefore requires agents to reason over sufficient evidence, resolve cross-source and temporal conflicts, and recognize when the available evidence is insufficient to establish an answer. To systematically evaluate these capabilities, we introduce MMEnterprise-Bench, a benchmark comprising 1,613 questions grounded in evolving multimodal records from simulated collaboration projects, covering three categories: Evidence Reasoning, Conflict Resolution, and Unanswerability. We evaluate 10 proprietary and open-source multimodal LLMs and find that even the strongest models struggle when evidence contains cross-source or temporal conflicts or spans multiple images. Moreover, increasing the retrieval budget or employing a larger retriever improves evidence recall but does not consistently translate into higher answer accuracy. These findings highlight the persistent challenges of reasoning over evolving workplace records and establish MMEnterprise-Bench as a testbed for developing more reliable enterprise agents. Code and data are available at https://mlvlab.github.io/MMEnterprise-Bench/.
hf.titleZh: MMEnterprise-Bench:评估演化中的多模态记录上的企业级 Agent
hf.summaryZh: 企业工作区中的文档、聊天与图表会随协作不断累积出同一信息的多个版本，可靠问答要求模型同时处理证据充分性、跨源与时间冲突，并识别证据不足以支撑答案的情形。MMEnterprise-Bench 基于模拟协作项目构建 1613 道题，划分为证据推理、冲突消解与不可回答三类，系统评测多模态 LLM 的上述能力。对 10 个闭源与开源多模态模型的评测显示，即使最强模型在证据含跨源或时间冲突、以及证据跨多张图片时仍明显吃力;增大检索预算或换用更强的检索器可提升证据召回，却不能稳定转化为更高的答题准确率。该基准为企业 Agent 的可靠性评测提供了可复用的测试床。
hf.reason: 企业 Agent 多模态评测基准，直接覆盖 Agent 与评测方法学方向

hf.title: Joints, Camera, Action! Co-Generating 3D Motion and Video for Arbitrary Rigs
hf.abstract: Video generation models can now depict remarkably realistic motion. Yet it is unclear how to use this motion beyond pixels: to animate a specific 3D asset and replay the animation in its 3D scene. For instance, a video model can show a monkey jumping over a crossbar, but it cannot return that jump as replayable 3D motion placed in the 3D scene. Here we present a model that directly co-generates the video and 3D motion for any supplied rig, along with a camera that registers this motion to the scene. Prior video-motion models either handle only human skeletons, often adding billions of parameters, or triangulate 3D motion from generated 2D pose maps. We instead keep 3D motion in a separate model that supports arbitrary skeletons, and connect it to a pretrained video model through a small set of cross-attention layers. This separation lets the motion model first learn how skeletons move from motion-only data, which is easier to obtain and augment than paired video. Additionally, our model learns to locate each joint in the video frames, which lets us recover the camera and place the 3D motion in the scene. To train across many skeletons, we use a generative video editor to place animated 3D assets in scenes suited to their actions, curating the edits so their known motion remains valid. Together with human and robot video, this yields nearly 200K training pairs. Our evaluations demonstrate that our model animates diverse rigs from text more faithfully than video-first pipelines, and its motion responds to the surrounding scene. It also turns video into rig motion, rig motion into video, and enables keyframe-based control of the 3D motion. Videos and additional results are available on our project page: https://research.nvidia.com/labs/par/projects/jca/.
hf.titleZh: 关节、相机、动作！为任意骨架联合生成3D运动与视频
hf.summaryZh: 视频生成模型能画出逼真的运动，却无法把运动还原成可在3D场景中重放的骨骼动画。这里让3D运动模型与预训练视频模型分离:运动模型先在更易获取的纯运动数据上学习任意骨架的运动规律，再通过少量cross-attention层与视频模型耦合，同时学习在视频帧中定位各关节以恢复相机、把运动放回场景;训练数据由生成式视频编辑器将动画3D资产置入匹配场景构建，加上人类与机器人视频共约20万对。评测显示其按文本驱动多种骨架比video-first流程更忠实，运动能响应周围场景，并支持视频转骨骼运动、运动转视频及关键帧控制。
hf.reason: 视频与3D运动联合生成，属视觉生成方向，与LLM后训练无关

hf.title: LLM2R: From Large Language Models to 3D Reassemblers
hf.abstract: 3D part assembly aims to reconstruct a complete shape from a set of unassembled parts by predicting a rigid SE(3) transformation for each part. Because the placement of a part is rarely determined by its own geometry, the task demands reasoning over the entire part set, and existing methods, which rely on pairwise relations or iterative generation and verification, scale poorly to objects with many parts. We present LLM2R, which casts part assembly as sequence modeling with a pretrained decoder-only large language model (LLM): a Point-BERT encoder and a Q-Former compress each part into a block of geometric tokens, the blocks of all parts are concatenated, and a causal LLM adapted with Low-Rank Adaptation (LoRA) processes the sequence in one forward pass. Causal attention, however, lets the hidden states of a part observe only the parts that precede it. LLM2R therefore appends a block of learnable summary tokens after the last part: these tokens follow every part, so their states aggregate the whole assembly at a constant token cost, and a part-aware pose head fuses each part's states with them before predicting its rotation and translation. One architecture thus handles semantic and geometric assembly and predicts all poses in a single non-autoregressive pass. LLM2R achieves the highest part accuracy and success rate on all three PartNet categories, the best rotation error, translation error, and part accuracy on PartNeXt, and the lowest translation error and fastest inference on Breaking Bad, where only a fracture-specialized method is more accurate. Its advantage grows with the number of parts: at 100 parts it exceeds GARF by 33.5 points in part accuracy on Breaking Bad and Assembler by 29.1 points on PartNet, and it transfers zero-shot to unseen categories with more than 16 points higher part accuracy than the strongest of three baselines.
hf.titleZh: LLM2R：从大语言模型到三维重装配器
hf.summaryZh: 三维零件装配需为每个零件预测SE(3)刚体变换，且零件位置取决于整体几何，现有方法依赖成对关系或迭代生成验证，零件数增多时难以扩展。LLM2R将其转化为序列建模：Point-BERT与Q-Former把每个零件压成一段几何token，所有零件块拼接后由LoRA适配的decoder-only LLM单次前向处理；针对因果注意力只能看到前序零件，在末尾追加可学习summary token汇聚全局信息，再由part-aware pose head融合预测旋转与平移，一次非自回归输出全部位姿。方法在PartNet三个类别上零件准确率与成功率最高，100零件时Breaking Bad上零件准确率超GARF 33.5点、PartNet上超Assembler 29.1点，并可零样本迁移到未见类别。
hf.reason: 三维零件装配属视觉重建低分方向，仅LLM作序列骨干带一点新意

hf.title: SpecKCast: Spectral Kalman Forecasting for Diffusion Acceleration
hf.abstract: Diffusion Transformers (DiTs) achieve high-fidelity image and video generation, but they suffer from substantial inference costs due to repeated transformer evaluations across many denoising steps. Feature caching reduces this cost by reusing features across denoising steps. Recent forecasting methods extend this idea by extrapolating features to skipped steps instead of reusing them. However, existing forecasting methods extrapolate the features they predict uniformly, even though the spatial-frequency components of these features change most at different stages of denoising. They also overlook that denoising progresses nonuniformly, so equal step intervals can correspond to very different amounts of change. These mismatches amplify forecast errors as more steps are skipped, limiting the achievable acceleration. We propose SpecKCast, a training-free method that forecasts the model output in the frequency domain. SpecKCast applies a 2D discrete cosine transform (DCT) to the output and tracks each coefficient with a lightweight Kalman filter along a band-specific time coordinate derived from the noise schedule. The filter tracks each coefficient's value and rate of change, and the transformer is evaluated only when the filter's forecast uncertainty exceeds a threshold. Experiments on FLUX.1-dev, Qwen-Image, Wan2.1-14B, and HunyuanVideo show that SpecKCast achieves a better trade-off between acceleration and fidelity than existing caching and forecasting methods, reaching up to 6x speedup with less than 0.05 GiB of additional memory.
hf.titleZh: SpecKCast：面向扩散加速的谱域 Kalman 预测
hf.summaryZh: 扩散 Transformer 做图像与视频生成时，需要在数十步去噪中反复调用主干网络；特征缓存通过跨步复用降低这部分开销，但现有预测式方法对所有特征一律外推，忽略了空间频率分量在不同去噪阶段的变化幅度并不相同，也忽略了等长的步间隔所对应的实际变化量并不一致，因此跳步越多，误差越大。SpecKCast 是一种无需训练的频域预测方法：它对模型输出施加二维 DCT，为每个系数配一个轻量 Kalman 滤波器，并沿由噪声调度导出的分频段时间坐标，同时跟踪该系数的取值与变化率；只有预测不确定度超过阈值时，才真正执行 Transformer。在 FLUX.1-dev、Qwen-Image、Wan2.1-14B、HunyuanVideo 上，它在加速与保真之间取得了更优折中，最高约 6 倍加速，额外显存低于 0.05 GiB。
hf.reason: 扩散生成推理加速，属明确低分方向

hf.title: Evolving Agent Interfaces
hf.abstract: Computer-use agents are limited by the interfaces humans give them. An agent may type a spreadsheet cell by cell when a single line of code would do, or print all two thousand lines of a file through a shell to find one function. Both the interfaces and the knowledge of when to use each are built by hand, which cannot keep pace with new applications, workflows, and models. We argue that interface design should itself be an agent capability. We introduce Agent S4, an autonomous computer-use scientist that builds Evolving Agent Interfaces from task experience. A meta-agent examines task agents' trajectories on synthetic training tasks, without success labels, and constructs and revises interfaces and usage knowledge in a repository. Population-based evolution then selects which repositories to develop further by their performance on validation tasks the meta-agent never sees, favoring changes that generalize beyond the seen tasks. On OSWorld V2, Agent S4, with Qwen3.8-27B and the evolved repository of interfaces, sets a new state of the art in open-source computer-use agents, reaching 21.3% binary score, 3.8 times the same model with fixed interfaces. This is above both GPT-5.5 (13.0%) and Claude Opus 4.8 (20.6%), at about 4.3% and 1.5% of their respective costs. On ScienceBoard, the evolved interfaces improve the success rate from 41.4% to 58.6% with the same model. These results suggest that useful interfaces can be evolved from experience, making autonomous interface design a source of improvement complementary to advances in models and harnesses. We open-source our code at https://github.com/simular-ai/agent-s.
hf.titleZh: 进化式智能体接口
hf.summaryZh: 计算机使用智能体受限于人工设计的接口，常逐格填写表格，或打印整份文件只为找一个函数。Agent S4把接口设计本身变成智能体能力：元智能体在无成功标签的合成任务轨迹上构建并修订接口与使用知识库，再以种群进化在未参与训练的验证任务上筛选可泛化的接口库。在OSWorld V2上，Qwen3-27B配合进化接口库取得21.3%二值得分，为固定接口的3.8倍，超过GPT-5.5（13.0%）与Claude Opus 4.8（20.6%），成本约为二者的4.3%与1.5%；ScienceBoard成功率由41.4%升至58.6%。
hf.reason: 接口自进化+元智能体，直击Agent与自我改进方向

hf.title: Specter: Fast MoE Inference via Quantization-Enabled Multi-Step Speculative Offloading
hf.abstract: Mixture-of-experts (MoE) models often exceed a single accelerator's memory capacity. Offloading experts to host memory creates a severe PCIe I/O bottleneck because data-dependent routing keeps transfers on the critical path. We present Specter, an inference system that uses quantization to combine speculative decoding with expert offloading. Its lightweight quantized draft model runs efficiently on device while preserving high-fidelity expert activation patterns. This provides accurate multi-step lookahead over future expert usage, allowing the runtime to organize expert movement and execution ahead of verification and improve both communication and execution efficiency. Under single-request inference, Specter achieves an average 1.50x (up to 1.88x) speedup in time per output token (TPOT) over the state-of-the-art system. Specter makes memory-constrained, single-GPU MoE inference more practical on commodity hardware. Our code is available at https://github.com/wwwwwf/specter_asplos.
hf.titleZh: Specter：基于量化的多步投机卸载实现快速 MoE 推理
hf.summaryZh: MoE 模型专家超出单卡显存时需卸载到主机内存，而数据相关的路由把 PCIe 传输压在关键路径上，形成严重 I/O 瓶颈。Specter 用轻量量化草稿模型在设备端做多步投机，该模型能保留高保真的专家激活模式，从而准确预判未来若干步会用到的专家，让运行时在验证之前就调度专家的搬运与执行，同时提升通信与计算效率。单请求推理下，每输出 token 时间（TPOT）相比当前最优系统平均加速 1.50 倍、最高 1.88 倍，使显存受限的单卡 MoE 推理在通用硬件上更可用。
hf.reason: MoE 推理系统，量化加投机解码解决专家卸载 I/O，命中系统效率方向

hf.title: Epi: Towards a Persistent, Self-Improving Agent for Autonomous Research
hf.abstract: We present Épi, an autonomous research agent that sustains investigations across model sessions and evolves its methods through accumulated experience. Épi combines persistent research history, hierarchical memory, branching and independent review to maintain research continuity, learn from experiments, and explore and revisit alternative approaches. Its experiments run across session boundaries, and a fixed verifier evaluates their outputs. Épi produced 120 record-setting results, comprising 20 numerical bound records across 12 families and 100 construction records across eight families. These include an approximately 84-fold narrower interval for the n-queens constant and a more than 3.6-million-fold narrower rigorous interval for the quartic Feigenbaum attractor dimension. Exact dual certificates establish that the Cohn-Elkies linear-programming bound cannot be sharp in dimensions 10 and 11. Beyond numerical improvements, Épi gives a computer-assisted proof of Tuza's conjecture for split graphs with an eight-vertex clique part and at most three triangle-active neighborhood types, with arbitrary multiplicities. We extend this research process to algorithmic coding with Épi-turbo, a lightweight configuration that develops executable solvers for tasks including vehicle routing, scheduling and production planning. On 30 FrontierOR tasks, Épi-turbo achieves a 5.4% higher total benchmark score than Codex at 64% of its model cost, using the same underlying model and reasoning effort. Épi is designed to support human understanding by connecting computational results to explicit methods and mathematical arguments that researchers can examine and build upon.
hf.titleZh: Épi：迈向持久、自我改进的自主研究智能体
hf.summaryZh: 面向跨会话、可积累经验的自主研究智能体:以持久研究历史、分层记忆、分支探索与独立评审维持研究连续性，实验跨会话运行并由固定验证器判定结果。产出120项刷新纪录的结果，含12个族的20项数值界纪录与8个族的100项构造纪录——n-queens常数区间收窄约84倍、四次Feigenbaum吸引子维数严格区间收窄逾360万倍，并以对偶证书证明Cohn-Elkies线性规划界在10、11维不可能取紧，另给出分裂图上Tuza猜想一类情形的计算机辅助证明。轻量配置Épi-turbo在30个FrontierOR任务上以64%的模型成本取得较Codex高5.4%的总分。
hf.reason: 自主科研智能体，持久记忆与自我改进，系统性强

hf.title: Breaking Diffusion: Parallel Reasoning with Draft Refinement
hf.abstract: Drafting an answer allows a reasoning model to reconsider each decision in the context of the others. Yet repeated diffusion denoising does not ensure that individually plausible token updates form a better answer together. We introduce Draft Refinement Language Models (DRLMs), which use a single denoiser to propose parallel revisions and evaluate a candidate draft. We train the denoiser to reconstruct every token from uniformly corrupted drafts, teaching both preservation and repair. Its predictions specify revisions directly, without a diffusion reverse transition. Evaluation requires a different use of these predictions: confidence in an existing token reflects both contextual support and evidence from observing the token itself. Using the known corruption process, we correct for this self-token evidence to estimate how well each token is supported by the prompt and the remaining draft. Aggregating these estimates yields a cavity energy computed in one forward pass, without an additional scoring model. Each round proposes a revision, reads the completed candidate in its revised context, and retains it only if its energy is lower. Across Countdown, Sudoku-Extreme, and Maze-Hard, our method outperforms autoregressive and discrete diffusion baselines. With 6M parameters, DRLM reaches 44.4% on Countdown-5 and 93.9% on Sudoku-Extreme. The results establish complete-draft parallel refinement as an effective alternative to reverse diffusion for complex reasoning.
hf.titleZh: 打破扩散：草稿精炼驱动的并行推理
hf.summaryZh: 一次性草稿让推理模型能在全局语境下重新审视每个决策，但反复扩散去噪并不保证逐 token 的局部合理更新会组合成更优答案。DRLM 用单一去噪器并行提出修订并评估候选草稿：训练时从均匀损坏的草稿重建每个 token，同时学会保留与修复，预测结果直接给出修订，无需扩散逆向转移。评估时利用已知的损坏过程扣除「看到 token 自身」带来的证据，一次性前向算出 cavity energy，作为 prompt 与其余草稿对该 token 支持度的估计；每轮只保留能量更低的候选。在Countdown、Sudoku-Extreme、Maze-Hard上优于自回归与离散扩散基线，6M参数下Countdown-5达44.4%、Sudoku-Extreme达93.9%。
hf.reason: 并行精炼推理范式新颖，但仅小规模谜题任务，分量有限

hf.title: EvaOmni: An Evidence-Grounded Benchmark for Audio-Visual Reasoning
hf.abstract: Omni LLMs can naturally locate key audio and visual evidence and integrate information across modalities for audiovisual reasoning. Existing audio-visual reasoning benchmarks that mainly rely on multiple-choice questions usually score models solely based on answer correctness, making it difficult to assess whether a model truly forms a reasoning chain from evidence to the correct answer. In addition, textual or unimodal shortcuts may allow models to answer correctly without analyzing the necessary audio-visual evidence, further weakening the reliability of evaluation benchmarks. To address these issues, we introduce EvaOmni, an evidence-grounded benchmark containing 392 videos and 1,027 purely human-annotated question-answer pairs, covering 15 capabilities and three levels: retrieval and localization, basic understanding, and complex reasoning. We design a series of rigorous annotation procedures in which experts annotate audio and visual evidence and construct video-based distractors; humans review whether questions meet strict inspection criteria, and finally models filter textual and unimodal shortcuts. Beyond high-quality question-answer pairs, we require models to simultaneously return the answer and supporting evidence intervals in order to evaluate the complete reasoning chain. We propose the Coverage Grounded Score (C.G.) to measure how much annotated evidence a model identifies, and the Bottleneck Grounded Score (B.G.) to penalize poor temporal localization in either modality; both are incorporated into answer correctness. Across 7 open-weight and 17 proprietary Omni LLMs, Gemini3.7-Flash achieved the highest overall accuracy (79.4%), C.G. (70.8%), and B.G. (35.1%). At Level 3, it reached 79.1% accuracy, but its B.G. was only 12.3%. These results show that even the most advanced models still have room for development in grounded audio-visual reasoning.
hf.titleZh: EvaOmni：一个以证据为基础的音视频推理基准
hf.summaryZh: 现有音视频推理基准大多按选择题答案的对错来打分，因此难以判断模型是否真正建立了从证据到答案的推理链，而文本或单模态捷径也会抬高分数。EvaOmni包含392个视频和1027条纯人工标注问答，覆盖15项能力和三个层级；标注时，专家标出音视频证据区间并构造同视频干扰项，再经人工审核和模型过滤以剔除捷径。评测要求模型同时给出答案和证据时间区间，并用Coverage/Bottleneck Grounded Score把时间定位质量计入正确性。在7个开源和17个闭源Omni模型中，Gemini3.7-Flash表现最佳，准确率79.4%、C.G. 70.8%、B.G. 35.1%，但复杂推理层B.G.仅12.3%，证据定位仍是短板。
hf.reason: 评测方法学契合，但音视频基准偏离核心方向

hf.title: PhysSkin++: Real-Time and Generalizable Physics-Based Animation via Self-Supervised Neural Skinning
hf.abstract: Generalizing real-time physics-based animation across diverse 3D shapes and spatial discretizations remains challenging. In this paper, we introduce PhysSkin++, a physics-informed framework that learns continuous neural skinning fields from static geometries to construct compact deformation subspaces. Specifically, we propose a Neural Skinning Fields Autoencoder that predicts shape-dependent deformation subspaces without per-object network training. To learn these subspaces without simulation trajectories, we develop a Physics-Informed Self-Supervised Learning strategy that combines skinning-field normalization with conflict-aware gradient correction, stabilizing joint optimization under physical and orthogonality constraints. The learned representation supports efficient reduced dynamics with user control and contact interactions, together with direct animation binding to meshes, point clouds, and 3D Gaussians. For prescribed rig animation, we further introduce a self-supervised complementarity objective to learn complementary elastic responses without enforcing complementarity constraints at runtime. Experiments demonstrate cross-shape generalization of the learned skinning fields, real-time reduced simulation, and applications to controllable, collision-aware, and rig-complementary animation.
hf.titleZh: PhysSkin++：通过自监督神经蒙皮实现实时且可泛化的物理动画
hf.summaryZh: 针对实时物理动画难以跨不同三维形状与空间离散化泛化的问题，构建了从静态几何学习连续神经蒙皮场的框架，以得到紧凑的变形子空间。核心是神经蒙皮场自编码器，无需逐物体训练即可预测与形状相关的变形子空间；同时提出物理信息自监督学习策略，结合蒙皮场归一化与冲突感知梯度校正，在物理与正交约束下稳定联合优化。该表示支持带用户控制与接触交互的高效降维动力学，并可直接绑定到网格、点云与3D高斯；实验展示了跨形状泛化、实时降维模拟，以及可控、碰撞感知与骨骼互补动画等应用。
hf.reason: 三维形状物理动画与图形学，与LLM方向无交集

hf.title: Painting Change Map as guidance for generating painting processes
hf.abstract: Digital art generation has undergone a massive paradigm shift, moving from static image synthesis to dynamic video generation that can mimic the human painting process. While existing models can synthesize visually stunning time-lapses of paintings being created or "unpainted," they largely treat the creative process as a black box. Current conditioning mechanisms are either too rigid, relying on static geometric cues like Canny edges or depth maps, or too holistic, utilizing simple scalar progress variables that offer no localized control. Consequently, users lack the agency to steer how a painting evolves over time. In this work, we argue that true control over the video generation of artwork requires a joint understanding of two fundamental dimensions: where an artist acts, and when those actions take place. To achieve this, we introduce the Painting Change Map, a novel spatio-temporal control mechanism that explicitly tracks normalized structural changes across a 1,000-timestep continuum, a resolution sufficient to capture fine-grained stroke-level changes while remaining computationally tractable. By mapping localized visual differences into an encoded RGB space, our representation enables fine-grained guidance for both the forward painting and reverse unpainting processes. Extensive benchmarking demonstrates the efficacy of our approach. We outperform existing control baselines and achieve competitive or superior results compared to state-of-the-art painting methods. Furthermore, under oracle conditions, our method surpasses all baselines by a significant margin. Code is available at https://github.com/Markus-Pobitzer/painting-change-map.
hf.titleZh: 将绘画变化图作为绘画过程生成的引导
hf.summaryZh: 现有绘画过程视频生成模型把创作过程当作黑箱：条件控制要么依赖 Canny 边缘、深度图等静态几何线索，过于刚性，要么使用标量进度变量，过于全局，用户无法局部地控制画面如何随时间演变。为此提出 Painting Change Map，一种时空控制表示，在 1000 步归一化时间轴上显式跟踪结构变化，将局部视觉差异编码进 RGB 空间，从而同时为正向绘画与逆向「去绘画」过程提供细粒度引导。实验中，该方法优于现有控制基线，与当前最优绘画方法相比达到相当或更优效果；在 oracle 条件下则大幅领先所有基线。
hf.reason: 艺术绘画视频生成，属视觉生成低分方向，与 LLM 无关

hf.title: From Short Clips to Real-Time Streams: Identity-Aware Supervision and Context-Efficient Generation for Video Face Swapping
hf.abstract: Video face swapping transfers the reference identity to a target video while preserving its other attributes and motion. Despite recent progress in reference-guided flow-based methods, jointly achieving faithful identity transfer, high fidelity, and real-time generation over long video streams remains challenging. To address this challenge, we rethink the task-specific structure of reference-guided video face swapping. First, face swapping changes only identity while preserving most visual content, yet flow-matching supervision is weakly sensitive to these changes. We therefore develop Joint Rec-ID Loss, which balances explicit identity supervision and latent reconstruction according to the noise level. Second, the target video already provides non-edited attributes and temporal dynamics, enabling generation with fewer spatial tokens and shorter temporal contexts through Face-RoI Generation and Short-Context Rollout Training. By integrating these designs, we propose StreamingSwap, a reference-guided flow-matching framework for real-time streaming video face swapping. We also introduce HumanFaceVid, comprising 1,000 hours of cinematic training data and evaluation sets of 200 short and 200 long videos. Experiments demonstrate that our method achieves competitive identity transfer and visual quality at 20 FPS on a single NVIDIA RTX 4090 GPU, with stable generation over videos up to 10 minutes long. Project webpage: https://aim-uofa.github.io/StreamingSwap/
hf.titleZh: 从短视频片段到实时流：视频换脸的身份感知监督与上下文高效生成
hf.summaryZh: 视频换脸需在保留目标视频其他属性与运动的前提下迁移参考身份，现有参考引导的流匹配方法难以同时兼顾身份保真、高画质与长视频流实时生成。为此提出StreamingSwap：用Joint Rec-ID Loss按噪声水平平衡显式身份监督与隐空间重建；利用目标视频已提供未编辑属性与时序动态，通过Face-RoI Generation与Short-Context Rollout Training减少空间token与时间上下文长度。配套构建HumanFaceVid数据集，含1000小时电影级训练数据与200条短视频、200条长视频评测集。实验在单张RTX 4090上以20 FPS完成换脸，身份迁移与画质具竞争力，并可对长达10分钟视频稳定生成。
hf.reason: 视频人脸换脸与生成，落在视觉生成低分方向

hf.title: DecisionPivot: A Diagnostic Benchmark for Decision Models in LLM Systems
hf.abstract: Decision models support routing, guardrails, and output verification in LLM systems. However, item accuracy alone cannot establish whether models make correct decisions across controlled variations or assign reliable confidence to their predictions. We introduce DecisionPivot, a diagnostic benchmark comprising 48 tasks and 40,033 items across seven decision roles. Its core track contains 7,800 items from 13 generated task families, organized into contrast groups with computed answers verified by independently implemented solvers. The complementary reference track contains 32,233 items from 35 public test sets, preserving their original evaluation metrics. We evaluate 40 decision models and 14 general models using documented, model-specific protocols, assessing item and contrast-group accuracy, probability ordering, calibration, and empirical selective coverage. Our results reveal substantial differences obscured by aggregate scores: two 27B models separated by only 2.6 points on the reference track achieve contrast-group accuracies of 70.1% and 44.2%. Across 2,400 binary contrast pairs, Perplexity Decider correctly ranks the positive member above the negative member in 92.3% of pairs but answers both members correctly in only 74.1%, exposing a gap between probability ordering and decision correctness. Models with similar item accuracy also differ in the reliability of their high-confidence predictions. On a separate 1,296-item subset, GLM-5.3 achieves 93.5\% contrast-group accuracy at a higher reasoning setting, compared with 81.5% at its lowest effort. By linking errors to pivotal details and difficulty levels, DecisionPivot provides fine-grained diagnostics of decision failures that aggregate evaluation alone cannot reveal.
hf.titleZh: DecisionPivot：LLM 系统中决策模型的诊断性基准
hf.summaryZh: LLM 系统中的决策模型承担路由、护栏与输出校验，但单项准确率无法说明模型能否在受控变化下稳定决策、并为预测给出可靠置信度。DecisionPivot 含 48 个任务、40,033 条样本：核心 track 的 7,800 条来自 13 个生成任务族，组织成对比组并由独立求解器验证答案；参考 track 的 32,233 条保留 35 个公开测试集的原指标；对 40 个决策模型与 14 个通用模型测量对比组准确率、概率排序、校准与选择性覆盖。参考 track 仅差 2.6 分的两个 27B 模型，对比组准确率为 70.1% 与 44.2%；2,400 组二选一中排序正确率 92.3%，而两者全对仅 74.1%，显示概率排序与决策正确性存在落差。
hf.reason: 决策可靠性诊断基准，属评测方法学方向，评测规模扎实

hf.title: FlowState: Execution State as Memory for Long-Horizon LLM Agents
hf.abstract: Long-horizon tasks require LLM agents to continually draw on information from earlier interactions. However, retaining the full history increases context costs, while compressing it risks losing details needed later, and the relevance of historical information often becomes apparent as the task progresses. To address these challenges, we propose FlowState, which treats execution state as memory that can be retained and revisited across requests, unifying current decision-making with the reuse of historical information. FlowState preserves semantically typed state nodes, their relations, and references to raw tool observations, separating persistent retention from on-demand access. Within a single execution loop, Incremental State Update (ISU) maintains the current state based on new inputs and feedback, while Progressive State Access (PSA) progressively reveals historical states and supporting evidence as needed during reasoning. Together, these mechanisms enable agents to reassess prior decisions in light of new information and guide subsequent actions. Compared with a full-context baseline using the same DeepSeek-V4-Flash model, FlowState improves the average success rate on MemoryArena and the average pass rate on τ^3-Bench by 4.55 and 13.95 percentage points, respectively, while reducing total token consumption by 43.2% and 40.6%. These results demonstrate the performance and efficiency advantages of FlowState on long-horizon tasks.
hf.titleZh: FlowState：以执行状态为记忆的长程LLM Agent
hf.summaryZh: 长程任务中直接保留完整历史会推高上下文成本，压缩历史又可能丢失后续所需细节。FlowState把执行状态本身作为可跨请求保留与重访的记忆，持久保存带语义类型的状节点、节点关系及对原始工具观测的引用，把长期保留与按需访问分离；在单次执行循环内，增量状态更新（ISU）依据新输入与反馈维护当前状态，渐进状态访问（PSA）在推理中按需逐步展开历史状态与证据，使Agent能结合新信息重新评估既有决策。以同一DeepSeek-V4-Flash为基座对比全上下文基线，在MemoryArena上平均成功率提升4.55个百分点，在τ^3-Bench上平均通过率提升13.95个百分点，总token消耗分别下降43.2%与40.6%。
hf.reason: Agent记忆与状态管理机制，直击长程Agent方向

hf.title: Event-STVG: Spatio-Temporal Video Grounding for Long-Form Event Reasoning
hf.abstract: Spatio-Temporal Video Grounding (STVG) aims to jointly localize a target in space and time given a natural-language query. Despite continued advances, existing STVG benchmarks remain largely centered on localizing targets through instance-specific descriptions, leaving them largely decoupled from long-form reasoning increasingly emphasized in multimodal large language models (MLLMs). In this paper, we introduce Event-STVG, a task that shifts STVG from locating what is described toward event-level reasoning by unifying long-form context, repeated-event reasoning, event localization, role inference, and multi-target grounding. To facilitate research on Event-STVG, we construct a large-scale benchmark comprising 4,016 annotated event occurrences across soccer and seven additional domains. Experiments with state-of-the-art MLLMs reveal substantial difficulty, with the strongest model achieving only 5.4% m-vIoU at the 10-minute horizon. Across domains, we consistently observe confusion among repeated same-type events, spatial grounding bottlenecks, and rare success in jointly grounding all required roles. Event-STVG establishes a new challenge for visual understanding in MLLMs, calling for future models that can jointly reason about complex events across space and time. Code and annotations are available at https://github.com/THU-KEG/EventSTVG
hf.titleZh: Event-STVG：面向长程事件推理的时空视频定位
hf.summaryZh: 现有STVG基准多依赖实例级描述定位目标，与MLLM日益强调的长程推理脱节。Event-STVG把任务推进到事件级推理，统一长上下文、重复事件推理、事件定位、角色推断与多目标grounding，并构建覆盖足球等八个领域、4,016个事件发生片段的大规模基准。最强MLLM在10分钟时间跨度上仅取得5.4% m-vIoU，暴露出同类重复事件混淆与空间定位瓶颈。该基准为视频理解与长程事件推理提供了新的评测挑战。
hf.reason: MLLM视频事件基准，属评测方法学，但偏视频定位

hf.title: EdgeKernelBench: Unified LLM-Driven Kernel Generation for Edge Backends
hf.abstract: Recent works show that LLMs can generate kernels with strong performance on server GPUs. Edge deployment presents distinct challenges because the hardware is heterogeneous, the software stacks are fragmented, and the resource budgets are tight. LLM kernel generation across diverse edge backends has yet to be studied systematically. We introduce EdgeKernelBench, which combines a unified IR deployment framework with a hierarchical benchmark for edge workloads. The unified IR captures reusable computation, scheduling, and memory decisions and connects to each target backend through a compiler interface. The benchmark spans progressively larger program scopes, from individual operators to compact model graphs, across representative edge application domains. We instantiate the design with TVM as a reference compiler and validate it across heterogeneous edge backends. With a single generation attempt, the best model achieves 64.5% Correct@1 but only 25.5% Fast@1.0. This gap shows that functional correctness does not consistently translate into performance gains. We therefore introduce the Layered Edge Kernel Agent (LEKA), which organizes optimization through a layered IR. On the agent evaluation subset, LEKA achieves 43.5% Fast@1.0, compared with 13.0% for direct generation and 26.1% for Claude Code. LEKA and Claude Code use the same base model and optimization budget. Together, EdgeKernelBench and LEKA support unified evaluation and layered optimization of kernels generated by LLMs across edge backends.
hf.titleZh: EdgeKernelBench:面向边缘后端的统一 LLM 驱动内核生成
hf.summaryZh: 针对边缘硬件异构、软件栈碎片化，使 LLM 生成的 kernel 难以跨后端复用与部署的问题，构建统一 IR 部署框架与分层基准，覆盖从单算子到小型模型图的程序范围，并以 TVM 作为参考编译器接入异构边缘后端。最佳模型单次生成仅 64.5% Correct@1，性能达标率更跌至 25.5% Fast@1.0，说明功能正确性难以稳定转化为实际加速。据此提出基于分层 IR 的 LEKA 智能体，在评测子集上 Fast@1.0 达 43.5%，高于直接生成的 13.0% 与同等预算下 Claude Code 的 26.1%。
hf.reason: 代码/kernel 生成基准与分层优化智能体，命中代码智能与 Agent 方向

hf.title: Good Judgment, Bad Advice: Decision-Model Controllers Raise Agent Cost Without Improving Success
hf.abstract: Agent scaffolds increasingly delegate small decisions (whether to stop, verify, or change approach) to cheaper models. We ask whether a typed decision model, Jev 1.13, consulted only at deterministic decision points, makes a Claude Sonnet 5.5 terminal agent cheaper without making it worse. In a pre-specified study on Terminal-Bench 2.1, we hold one agent loop fixed and vary only the controller: none, deterministic rules, a small LLM (Claude Haiku 5.5) answering the same questions, Jev, and a placebo that samples Jev's development-phase choice frequencies at the same moments. On 21 held-out tasks (315 trials), Jev raised cost per attempt by 19% (geometric-mean ratio 1.19, 95% CI 1.02-1.36) at an identical pass rate (73.0% vs. 73.0%). Jev was cheaper than the small-LLM controller (ratio 0.81) but 22% more expensive than the placebo, and no pass-rate difference between arms was detectable. Offline, Jev ranked finish requests better than the alternatives (AUROC 0.78 vs. 0.62 for rules and 0.60 for the small LLM) but was poorly calibrated: its mean probability that a run was complete was 0.50 when 87% of those runs passed, so it asked the agent to verify work that was already correct. No controller ever chose to abandon a run. Informative decision signals did not become useful interventions; we discuss what that would require.
hf.titleZh: 好判断，坏建议：决策模型控制器抬高 Agent 成本却未提升成功率
hf.summaryZh: Agent scaffold 越来越多把「是否停止、是否验证、是否换方法」这类小决策交给更便宜的模型，本文检验这种委托是否真能降本而不降质。研究在 Terminal-Bench 2.1 上固定同一 agent 循环，只替换控制器：无控制器、确定性规则、小模型 Claude Haiku 5.5、类型化决策模型 Jev 1.13，以及按 Jev 开发期选择频率采样的安慰剂。21 个留出任务共 315 次试验中，Jev 使每次尝试成本上升 19%（几何均值比 1.19，95% CI 1.02–1.36），通过率持平于 73.0%；它比小模型控制器便宜（比值 0.81），却比安慰剂贵 22%，各臂间通过率无可检测差异。离线看 Jev 对完成请求的排序更优（AUROC 0.78，规则 0.62、小模型 0.60），但校准很差：其判定运行完成的平均概率为 0.50 时实际 87% 通过，因而频繁要求 agent 去验证本已正确的结果，且没有任何控制器选择放弃运行。
hf.reason: Agent 控制器成本与成功率实证，命中 Agent/scaffold 方向

hf.title: HarnessRL: Co-Evolving Policies with a Just-in-Time Training Harness for Open-Ended RL
hf.abstract: Rubric-based reinforcement learning (RL) trains policies for open-ended generation with natural-language criteria as rewards, but these rewards can become ineffective as training progresses. We identify two failure modes. Under non-discriminative rewards, scores collapse to uniformly low or high values due to insufficient exploration or a mismatch between task difficulty and policy capability. Under spurious rewards, higher scores do not correspond to better responses. Both reflect a training configuration whose task sampling, exploration, and evaluation stay fixed as the policy evolves. We introduce HarnessRL, a training-time harness that co-evolves with the policy through three interfaces for task sampling, rollout guidance, and rubric criteria. HarnessRL maintains a training-time memory from which a harness evolver retrieves within-task history and cross-task evidence. Using this evidence, the evolver attributes each reward failure to the interface whose update can address it. It then runs a proposer and just-in-time critic loop in which the critic accepts a candidate update only after measuring its effect on the current frozen policy, returning rejected candidates for revision. We also curate Rubric-Mix-10k, a five-domain training and evaluation suite for open-ended RL across medical, science, writing, role-play, and instruction-following tasks. On Rubric-Mix-10k, HarnessRL outperforms the strongest baselines by 2.8 to 3.1 points across both 4B and 9B model scales and nearly halves the training steps to its best checkpoint. Code and data are available at https://github.com/Tongyi-ConvAI/Qwen-Character/tree/main/HarnessRL.
hf.titleZh: HarnessRL：面向开放式 RL，让策略与即时训练 Harness 协同演化
hf.summaryZh: 基于 rubric 的 RL 用自然语言准则作为奖励来训练开放式生成，但随训练推进会出现两类失效：奖励缺乏区分度导致分数塌缩，以及奖励虚假导致高分并不对应更好回答；其根源是任务采样、探索与评估在策略演化时保持固定。HarnessRL 把训练配置本身做成与策略共演化的 harness，通过任务采样、rollout 引导与 rubric 准则三个接口，配合训练期记忆与 harness evolver，把奖励失效归因到具体接口，并用 proposer 与即时 critic 闭环，在冻结的当前策略上实测候选更新效果后再采纳。同时构建覆盖医学、科学、写作、角色扮演与指令遵循五个领域的 Rubric-Mix-10k。在 4B 与 9B 规模上，HarnessRL 比最强基线高 2.8 至 3.1 分，达到最佳 checkpoint 所需训练步数近乎减半。
hf.reason: 开放式 rubric RL 与 harness 共演化，正中后训练与 Agent 方向
